customManagers.description: Track prometheus-operator releases for the arm64-pin workaround (see docs/decisions/cluster-monitoring.md) — manual review only, a newer tag doesn't mean arm64 is fixed

packageRules.description: LinuxServer.io images use 1.x.y-lsNNN versioning — regex extracts build number for correct comparison
Gotenberg: stay on 8.x until Paperless-ngx supports v9
Apache Tika: image has no OCI source label, so link the CHANGES.txt of the matching release tag (image 3.4.0.0 -> tag 3.4.0)
Postgres: stay on 18.x for Paperless-ngx and TeslaMate until both support v19 (major upgrade also needs dump/restore or pg_upgrade)
Minor, patch and digest updates merge automatically once approved — branch protection requires a review, automerge never bypasses it
Major updates: no automerge, merge manually after review

kube-prometheus-stack: review every update incl. major — a chart release can silently bump a sub-component to a broken image (see the prometheus-operator arm64 incident in docs/decisions/cluster-monitoring.md); merges automatically once approved
prometheus-operator arm64-pin tracker: check arm64 availability before approving; merges automatically once approved

Flux system manifests (gotk-components.yaml, picked up by the flux manager's default file pattern) only carry a '# Flux Version:' comment — there is no place for a digest, so a pinDigest update always fails with 'update failure' on renovate/pin-dependencies
